title: Design System: Nawres Ben Rhouma — Portfolio

butter-ground.purpose: The page itself: near-white with a warm tint, never pure white.

warm-band.purpose: The alternate section tone, applied full-bleed to .section--alt.

sheet-white.purpose: The lifted content surface: panels, cards, timeline bodies, note sheets, the CV page.

espresso-ink.purpose: All primary text, the brand mark, and the secondary button's ground.

bark-muted.purpose: Labels, dates, meta lines, nav links at rest, secondary prose.

sand-border.purpose: Hairlines: field rows, section rules, the header underline, column dividers.

sand-border-strong.purpose: Control outlines only; roughly 3.5:1 on the butter ground, so never used under text.

forest-accent.purpose: The only accent: the closing words of the name and of every heading, links, the primary button, the pill, timeline and bullet markers, the selected folder tab, the focus ring.

forest-action-hover.purpose: Hover state of the filled primary button in light mode.

forest-soft.purpose: The accent's only tinted surface: the availability pill and the selection highlight.

mint-action-dark.purpose: Dark mode only: the filled primary button, one step below the mint accent so it does not flare on the dark ground.

display.purpose: The hero name only, set two-tone with the surname in the accent and a full stop.

panel-title.purpose: The project name inside a folder panel; near-display scale, because the work sheet is the page's second hero.

headline.purpose: Section h2: two clauses, the second in an accent span, ending in a full stop, followed by a hover-revealed # anchor.

title.purpose: h3: timeline roles, skill groups, learning columns, note titles.

body.purpose: All prose, capped at a 68ch measure (62ch in About and Education). Steps to 1.25rem for the hero statement and the contact lead.

small.purpose: Meta lines, dates, notes, footer, print hint.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked labels on field rows, contact rows, facts-card terms and timeline dates.

role-line.purpose: The hero role directly under the name; the widest tracking on the page, used once.

code.purpose: Technology chips and status tokens only.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The only elevation: white sheets lifted off the butter page. One altitude, never raised on hover.

shadows.name: sheet-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: The same token resolved in dark mode as a hairline ring; dark-on-dark drop shadows read as smudge.

shadows.name: folder-fuse
shadows.purpose: Thrown upward by the selected folder tab so tab and panel read as one continuous sheet.

shadows.name: timeline-marker-ring
shadows.purpose: Rings the accent disc in the current section ground so the marker sits on the rail, not beside it. Uses var(--alt) inside .section--alt.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition on the site.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and chevron state feedback.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: The sliding nav indicator (transform only, no layout).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: sections fade up 14px once as they enter. JS-only; never initialised under prefers-reduced-motion, and pinned to its visible state under @media print.

motion.name: reduced-motion-scope
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scroll, the reveal, the nav indicator slide and the chevron rotation, but keeps colour and border transitions so state changes still acknowledge the action.

breakpoints.name: hero-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Hero drops from 7:5 to a single column.

breakpoints.name: wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Header wraps to 6.5rem with the nav as a masked scroll strip; facts card, panel grid and skill rows go single-column; dividers rotate from left edges to top edges.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Section gutters drop to 1rem, section padding to 3rem, field and contact rows stack.

layout.name: content-max
layout.purpose: The centre column of the full-bleed three-column section grid.

layout.name: measure
layout.purpose: Paragraph cap; About and Education tighten to 62ch.

layout.name: header-height
layout.purpose: Sticky header height, kept in sync with scroll-padding-top; 6.5rem below 900px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per section: View work, Get in touch.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.125rem; font-family: var(--font-body, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; background: var(--action, #2f6b3a); color: var(--accent-contrast, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--action, #2f6b3a); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #245530); border-color: var(--action-hover, #245530); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f6b3a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The quiet second action beside the primary; hover swaps border and text to the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.125rem; font-family: var(--font-body, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #2b2417); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #8f8058); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f6b3a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Availability Pill
components.description: Location and availability above the hero name; the only tinted accent surface on the page.
components.html: Based in Tunis · Open to remote, part-time roles
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem; font-family: var(--font-body, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); background: var(--accent-soft, #e6f0e6); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-pill__dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); }

components.name: Two-Tone Heading
components.description: Every section heading: a plain first clause, an accent closing clause, a full stop, and a # anchor that appears on hover or focus.
components.html: Backend first, growing outward. #
components.css: .ds-h2 { font-family: var(--font-heading, Gabarito, sans-serif); font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; color: var(--text, #2b2417); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-accent { color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); } .ds-anchor { margin-left: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); text-decoration: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-h2:hover .ds-anchor, .ds-anchor:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-anchor:hover { color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); }

components.name: Facts Card
components.description: The hero's right column: five label/value rows on a white sheet, last value in the accent.
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); margin: 0; background: var(--sheet, #fff); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 12px 32px rgba(56,42,12,0.14)); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-body, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif); } .ds-facts dt, .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e8dcb6); } .ds-facts dt { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); padding-top: calc(1rem + 0.25em); } .ds-facts dd { font-weight: 600; text-align: right; color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-facts dt:nth-last-of-type(1), .ds-facts dd:nth-last-of-type(1) { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-facts dd:last-of-type { color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); }

components.name: Folder Tabs and Panel
components.description: The structural signature: the selected tab takes the sheet colour and fuses into the panel below, whose top-left corner is squared. Every tab holds the 2.75rem minimum target. Tab semantics and the visible tab row are added by JavaScript; without it the panels stack as separate sheets.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-tabs__list { display: none; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0 1rem 0 0; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-tabs__list--enhanced { display: flex; } .ds-tab { flex: none; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.125rem; background: rgba(43, 36, 23, 0.08); border: 0; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-body, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #2b2417); background: rgba(43, 36, 23, 0.14); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); background: var(--sheet, #fff); padding-top: 0.95rem; box-shadow: 0 -8px 20px rgba(56, 42, 12, 0.08); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f6b3a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-panel { padding: 2rem; background: var(--sheet, #fff); border-radius: 0 12px 12px 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 12px 32px rgba(56,42,12,0.14)); } .ds-panel__title { font-family: var(--font-heading, Gabarito, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.6rem + 2.6vw, 3.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-panel__meta { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); }

components.name: Technology Chip
components.description: A one-word technology token in Source Code Pro on the raised butter tint; inline, wrapping, never interactive.
components.css: .ds-tags { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-tags li { padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; background: var(--bg-elevated, #f7f0da); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e8dcb6); border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-code, "Source Code Pro", monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text, #2b2417); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Token
components.description: An inline honesty marker attached to a heading: Core in the accent, Growing in ink, Completed muted. Outline only, never filled.
components.css: .ds-h3 { font-family: var(--font-heading, Gabarito, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-status { display: inline-block; vertical-align: 0.15em; margin-left: 0.5rem; padding: 0.05rem 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-code, "Source Code Pro", monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #8f8058); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status--core { color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); border-color: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e8dcb6); } .ds-nav__list { list-style: none; display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-nav__link { display: inline-block; padding: 1.25rem 0; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-nav__link[aria-current="true"] { color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-nav--has-indicator .ds-nav__link[aria-current="true"] { border-bottom-color: transparent; } .ds-nav__indicator { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; width: 100px; background: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); transform: translateX(0) scaleX(0.6); transform-origin: 0 0; transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f6b3a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.css: .ds-note { background: var(--sheet, #fff); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 12px 32px rgba(56,42,12,0.14)); font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-note > summary { display: block; padding: 1rem 2rem; padding-right: 3.25rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; position: relative; } .ds-note > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-note > summary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 2rem; top: 50%; width: 0.6rem; height: 0.6rem; border-right: 2px solid var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg); transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-note[open] > summary::after { transform: translateY(-30%) rotate(-135deg); } .ds-note__heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; } .ds-note__title { font-family: var(--font-display, Gabarito, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-note__meta { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); } .ds-note__body { padding: 0 2rem 1.5rem; } .ds-note > summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f6b3a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.css: .ds-timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 2rem; position: relative; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #2b2417); } .ds-timeline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0.45rem; top: 0.6rem; bottom: 0.6rem; width: 2px; background: var(--border, #e8dcb6); } .ds-timeline__item { position: relative; padding: 0 0 2rem; } .ds-timeline__item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-timeline__item::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2rem; top: 0.35rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #2f6b3a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--bg, #fffcf2); } .ds-timeline__dates { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #5b4e35); } .ds-timeline__body { background: var(--sheet, #fff); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 12px 32px rgba(56,42,12,0.14)); padding: 1.5rem 2rem; }

narrative.overview:
A near-white page that behaves like good paper: butter-tinted, quiet, and generous with air. Everything structural is achieved by tone and edge rather than by decoration — the ground alternates between two warm near-whites section by section, and pure white sheets float on top of it carrying the content that needs to be read closely. The one thing that raises its voice is forest green, and it is spent almost entirely on endings: the surname and its full stop, the second clause of every section heading, the timeline markers, the selected folder tab. The name ends in green; so does the page's argument.

The density is document-like without being a document. Headings are set in Gabarito at 800 and tracked tight, so they read as built rather than typed; body text is Source Sans 3 at 1.0625rem on a 1.6 line, capped at a 68ch measure so no line becomes a scanning chore. Source Code Pro appears only where content is literally a token — a technology chip, a status marker — which keeps the monospace signal honest.

What the world refuses is equally load-bearing. It refuses the plain-document look (hence the sheets, the alternating ground, the folder tabs) and it refuses the copy of either reference that seeded it (hence the butter tint, Gabarito, and green in place of the references' orange and blue). It carries no photography and no invented metrics; credibility comes from typography, spacing and detail rather than from imagery or numbers.
narrative.northStarProvenance: Derived from the direction contract in .impeccable/surfaces/index-html.md and PRODUCT.md; no user was available to confirm the qualitative language.
keyCharacteristics: Butter-tinted near-white ground (#fffcf2) alternating with a warmer tone (#f6f2e6), full-bleed, section by section
Pure white sheets on a single soft offset shadow in light; a hairline ring in dark
One accent, forest green (#2f6b3a) in light and mint (#86cf8f) in dark, spent on endings
Gabarito 700/800 display and headings; Source Sans 3 body; Source Code Pro only in chips and status tokens
One authored entrance motion, JS-only and reduced-motion aware; every surface works with JavaScript off

rules.name: The Green Full Stop Rule
rules.body: The accent is reserved for the ending: the surname and its period, the second clause of every h2, and the small terminal signals (timeline dots, list markers, the selected tab, the last facts value). It never tints a large surface, never appears twice in the same role on one screen, and never acquires a companion hue.

rules.name: The Hairline Two-Tier Rule
rules.body: Content separation uses Sand Border; interactive outlines use Sand Border Strong. Never put Sand Border Strong under text or Sand Border around a control.

rules.name: The Warm White Rule
rules.body: There is no pure white ground. White appears only as a sheet lifted off the butter page; if a surface is the page itself, it is tinted.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Heading Rule
rules.body: Every h1 and h2 is written as two clauses: a plain first half in ink and a closing half in the accent, terminated by a full stop. Headings are statements, not labels.

rules.name: The Mono Reserve Rule
rules.body: Source Code Pro is permitted in exactly two places: technology chips and status tokens. Prose, headings, dates and labels never use it.

rules.name: The Balanced Measure Rule
rules.body: Headings carry text-wrap: balance; paragraphs carry a 68ch cap (62ch inside About and Education). Nothing on the page runs the full 76rem as text.

rules.name: The Alternating Ground Rule
rules.body: Section tone alternates via .section--alt across the full bleed. Never tint only the content column; never run two alternate sections back to back.

rules.name: The Edge-to-Center Rule
rules.body: Content lives in the middle column of the section grid at a 76rem cap. New sections adopt the grid rather than inventing their own container.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: There is a single shadow token and a single altitude. Hover never raises a surface; state is shown in colour and border, never in lift.

rules.name: The Dark Hairline Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, elevation is a 1px ring, not a shadow. Do not port a light-mode drop shadow into the dark palette.

rules.name: The Four Radii Rule
rules.body: 12 / 8 / 6 / 999. Any new corner picks one of them; nothing on this page is square except a table edge or a fused tab corner.

rules.name: The Scoped Stillness Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion removes movement, not feedback. Switch off transforms, entrances and sliding indicators; leave colour and border transitions alone.

rules.name: The Print-Safe State Rule
rules.body: Any element that starts hidden or displaced must be pinned to its resolved state under @media print. A section that only appears after a scroll event does not exist on paper.

dos: Do keep the accent on endings — the closing clause, the terminal marker, the selected state — per The Green Full Stop Rule.
Do write every section heading as two clauses with the second in an accent span and a full stop at the end.
Do alternate section tone with .section--alt full-bleed, and put new content in the section grid's middle column at the 76rem cap.
Do lift content on the single sheet shadow (0 12px 32px rgba(56, 42, 12, 0.14)) and let the dark theme resolve it to a hairline ring.
Do spend the 8px module: 4rem section padding, 2rem sheet padding, 1.5rem between grouped blocks.
Do ship every enhancement as an enhancement — tabs, the nav indicator, the reveal and the toggle each have a defined no-JS state, and a defined print and reduced-motion state.
Do give every interactive control a 2.75rem minimum target (buttons, icon links, the toggle, folder tabs).
Do keep text within the 68ch measure and hairlines at 1px.
Do use the accent-contrast token on any filled accent surface instead of hard-coding white.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or a tinted accent surface beyond the availability pill.
Don't use pure white as a page ground, or a shadow anywhere in dark mode.
Don't raise a surface on hover or add a second elevation level; state is colour and border only.
Don't set body copy, headings, dates or labels in Source Code Pro — chips and status tokens only.
Don't put Sand Border Strong (#8f8058) under text; it is a control outline, not a text or divider colour.
Don't add a radius outside 12 / 8 / 6 / 999 (the folder tab's 10px top corners are the one fused exception).
Don't add a second authored motion, or any transform-based motion that is not switched off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't ship a component whose content only exists once JavaScript runs.
Don't add photography, logos, testimonials or metric callouts; this world carries none.
